The 2004 rule that forced at most half first, half of the remainder after a year and the rest after two years was cancelled on 2014-02-10, so nothing makes you wait. One transfer is the cheapest: each extra transfer pays the 1‰ fee again, capped at RMB 260, plus the RMB 150 cable charge.

detail: If you choose instalments, art. 8 still requires the previous approval and 核准件 each time, so the second and third transfers are slower than the first but no longer compulsory.

detail: Art. 6: one application per deceased person; it may be paid in one go or in several transfers, and there is no two-year staging. Different deceased people need separate applications.

Inheritance is generally not US gross income for a US person, but the account was reportable while it existed.
